title: Cardano Ecosystem Adoption Campaign through content creators (Amplification)

ms.promise:
Output: Development of a strategic campaign plan, creation of key narratives, and content creator partnerships.
Sub-points:
• Create a detailed campaign strategy outlining the goals, target audience, and channels.
• Communicate with key stakeholders to see which posts to amplify.
• Identify and finalize a list of content creators for collaboration.
• Onboard content creators, aligning them with the campaign’s goals and message.
Output: Amplify big news in the ecosystem by having content creators repost, quote repost and speak about the news.
Sub-points:
• KOLs and content creators publish content according to the strategy and timeline.
• Ensure that all KOLs follow the content calendar and campaign guidelines.
• Monitor and track reach, engagement, and conversion metrics in real-time.
ms.criteria:
1. A finalized campaign plan, including: Key themes, timeline for upcoming narrative amplifications, and content creation guidelines.
2. At least 10 content creators onboarded, with confirmed participation.
3. A Google Sheet reporting framework is shared with stakeholders.
